key_phrases.phrase: Art igara rwego mu kwerekana ibitekerezo.
key_phrases.translation: Art remains a tool in explaining ideas.

key_phrases.phrase: Art igara rwego kubera gutanga inguvu z’umwete.
key_phrases.translation: Art remains a tool because of giving strength to movements.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Globalisation yatanze ubushakashatsi mu bihugu bikomeye, ahubwo byatanze na amahoro.
dialogue.translation: Globalization has reduced poverty in many countries, but it has also brought peace.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nka iki? Ese ntibishoboka kugira ubushakashatsi n’amahoro mu gihe kimwe?
dialogue.translation: How so? Isn’t it possible to have poverty and peace at the same time?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kubera globalisation, bishoboka kubera ko bihugu birengagiza kwiyongera kwiga.
dialogue.translation: Because of globalization, it’s possible because countries are encouraged to continue learning.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ibyo ni ibitekerezo by’ukuri, ariko kwerekana gute ibyo bituma ubushakashatsi bunguka?
dialogue.translation: Those are true thoughts, but how do you explain why poverty decreases?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Globalisation itegura indango z’ubumenyi n’ubucuruzi, ibyo bituma ubushakashatsi bunguka.
dialogue.translation: Globalization opens doors to knowledge and trade, which causes poverty to decrease.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kwemeza ko ibyo ni byo, ariko ese ntiharimo ibiyobyabwenge?
dialogue.translation: Confirm that this is the case, but aren’t there any drawbacks?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mu by’ukuri, harimo ibiyobyabwenge, nka ubushingantahe bw’amabanga.
dialogue.translation: In fact, there are drawbacks, like the loss of cultural identity.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ibyo ni ko globalisation irimo ibitekerezo by’ubushingantahe n’ubwiza.
dialogue.translation: That’s how globalization has both positive and negative aspects.

key_phrases.phrase: Globalisation yatanze ubushakashatsi mu bihugu bikomeye
key_phrases.translation: Globalization has reduced poverty in many countries

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nfatanye n’abandi mu kwishyura mu mibereho y’ubutunzi kandi kwirinda ubwoko bwacu.
dialogue.translation: I joined others in participating in wealth activities and protecting our clan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kubera ubushakashatsi bwacu, twakeneye kwihangana nka bantu bose.
dialogue.translation: Because of our diversity, we need to unite as all people.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ahariko, ubwoba bwo kwirakanira buri kintu bwarashobora gutuma tugakwiye kwirinda ubwoko bwacu.
dialogue.translation: However, the fear of reconciling everything might make us need to protect our clan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kandi n’ubushakashatsi bwo mu mibereho yacu bwoshobora gutuma twihangana neza.
dialogue.translation: And the diversity in our activities can help us unite well.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nka abanyarwanda, twakeneye kwirakanira kugira ngo tubane neza.
dialogue.translation: As Rwandans, we need to reconcile so that we can live well together.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, kwirinda ubwoko bwacu ntibishoboka ahanditse kwishyura mu mibereho y’ubutunzi.
dialogue.translation: Rather, protecting our clan is not possible without participating in wealth activities.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kandi ubushakashatsi bwacu bwoshobora gutuma twihangana neza kandi twirinde ubwoko bwacu.
dialogue.translation: And our diversity can help us unite well and protect our clan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kubera ibyo, twakeneye kwirakanira kugira ngo tubane neza mu mibereho yacu yose.
dialogue.translation: Because of that, we need to reconcile so that we can live well in all our activities.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Niba ubushakashatsi buri mu buzima, ese uburyo twongeye kwihangana?
dialogue.translation: If hardship is part of life, isn’t it a way we should continue to strive?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ego, kandi niba tukenera gukena ubwoba, turashobora kwirakanira neza.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and if we need to accept fear, we can discuss it properly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kugira ubutunzi nta cyo kibaza, ariko kwishyura ni cyo kiyobora.
dialogue.translation: Having wealth is not the goal, but sharing is what guides.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Niba twongeye kwirinda ubwoko bwo kugira ibintu, turashobora kugira ubuzima bwiza.
dialogue.translation: If we continue to avoid the type of having things, we can have a good life.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ariko ese kwihangana kugira uburyo bw’ubuzima ni ubwenge?
dialogue.translation: But isn’t striving to have a way of life wisdom?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ego, kandi niba tukenera kwirakanira neza, turashobora gukena ubwoba.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and if we need to discuss it properly, we can accept fear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ubwenge ni ukwigira uburyo bw’ubuzima, si gukenera ubutunzi.
dialogue.translation: Wisdom is having a way of life, not needing wealth.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kwishyura ni ubwoko bw’ubuzima bwiza, nta cyo kibaza.
dialogue.translation: Sharing is the type of a good life, there’s no goal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Rero, kwirakanira neza ni uburyo bw’ubuzima bwiza.
dialogue.translation: Therefore, discussing properly is the way of a good life.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Niba tubishyiye ubushakashatsi, tugomba kwiyongera gutegura amakuru yacu mu ijoro ry'iteknolojija.
dialogue.translation: If we prioritize freedom, we must continue to protect our data in the digital age.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, kubera ubushingantahe, bishoboka ko gutanga amakuru yacu bishobora kwemeza uburenganzira.
dialogue.translation: But, because of security, giving up our data might confirm safety.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nka one, ariko kwiga ibitekerezo by'abandi birashobora kwerekana amasaha.
dialogue.translation: Like that, but learning others' thoughts can reveal vulnerabilities.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ni byo, ariko tugomba kwiyongera kwerekana ubushingantahe n'ubushakashatsi.
dialogue.translation: That's true, but we must continue to explain security and freedom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mu by'ukuri, gutegura amakuru yacu n'ubushakashatsi ni ibintu bishoboka.
dialogue.translation: In reality, protecting our data and freedom are possible.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, tugomba gutanga ikimenyetso ko twifuze kwemeza uburenganzira.
dialogue.translation: But, we must give a sign that we need to confirm safety.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kubera ibyo, kwiga n'kwerekana ni uburyo bwo kwiyongera.
dialogue.translation: Because of that, learning and explaining are ways to continue.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nka ibyo usabye, tugomba kwiyongera gutegura ubushakashatsi n'ubushingantahe.
dialogue.translation: Like what you said, we must continue to protect freedom and security.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ndagushaka kwerekana ibitekerezo byanjye kuri ubushakashatsi bw’amaboko y’ibihugu.
dialogue.translation: I want to explain my thoughts on the influence of countries' soft power.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kweli, ni ikintu cy’ubwenge gukoresha ubushakashatsi mu gutuma abandi bishwe na migenzo yawe.
dialogue.translation: Truly, it’s a sign of wisdom to use influence to make others adopt your values.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, ntekereza ko ubushakashatsi bukwiye kwiyongera kugirwa ubwenge, kubera ko bishobora gutuma abantu bishwe.
dialogue.translation: But rather, I think influence should continue to be used wisely, because it can cause people to be swayed.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Iyo ni ukuri, ariko ubushakashatsi bwo mu bihe bya none burimo burimo.
dialogue.translation: That’s true, but influence in today’s world is everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ndagushaka kwerekana ko ubushakashatsi bwo mu buryo bw’amaboko y’ibihugu bukwiye gukoreshwa neza.
dialogue.translation: I want to explain that the influence of countries' soft power should be used properly.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ubwenge bwawe ni bwiza, ariko ese ubushakashatsi bwo bukwiye kwiyongera gukoreshwa?
dialogue.translation: Your wisdom is good, but shouldn’t influence continue to be used?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ego, ariko kubera ibintu byinshi, ubushakashatsi bukwiye kwiyongera gukoreshwa neza.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but because of many things, influence should continue to be used wisely.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kweli, ubushakashatsi ni ikintu cy’ubwenge, kandi bukwiye gukoreshwa mu buryo bw’amaboko y’ibihugu.
dialogue.translation: Truly, influence is a sign of wisdom and should be used in the way of countries' soft power.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ndagushaka kwiyongera kwiga kuri ubwenge bw’abantu mu kwerekana ibintu.
dialogue.translation: I want to continue learning about human wisdom in explaining things.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ego, ariko kubera iki ubwenge ntabwo bushobora kwerekana byose?
dialogue.translation: True, but why can’t wisdom explain everything?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, harimo ibintu dutazi kweli, kandi ubushakashatsi bwacu butuma tushaka kwiyongera gutegura.
dialogue.translation: But rather, there are things we don’t know, and our curiosity causes us to want to continue exploring.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: None se ibitekerezo bya science birahuye byose?
dialogue.translation: But aren’t the thoughts of science complete?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oya, ahubwo science igira amahame mu kwerekana ibintu bihambaye.
dialogue.translation: No, but rather science has limits in explaining complex things.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nuko rero, ubwenge ntabwo bushobora gutuma dukwiye kwiyongera kwiga?
dialogue.translation: So, can’t wisdom cause us to need to continue learning?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ego, kandi ubushakashatsi bwacu ni ico dusiga mu kwiga.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and our curiosity is what keeps us in learning.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nuko rero, turashaka kwerekana ibintu dutazi, ariko turabimenya ko harimo amahame.
dialogue.translation: So, we want to explain things we don’t know, but we understand there are limits.

dialogue.text: Ndagukunda uburyo ubushakashatsi bwo mu kuganira kwawe.
dialogue.translation: I appreciate the clarity in your argument.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, nashaka kwerekana ibitekerezo byanjye kuri icyo kibazo.
dialogue.translation: Rather, I want to explain my thoughts on that issue.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kweli, ubwenge bwawe burimo bugaragaza ko ugishaka gutanga amakuru menshi.
dialogue.translation: Truly, your wisdom shows that you want to provide more information.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Because we all have thoughts, it’s possible to continue the discussion.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: If we explain well, confusion will diminish.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Rather, I think that providing relevant information is the issue.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Truly, on that issue, wisdom has value.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kubera ibyo, nashaka kwiyongera mu kwerekana ibitekerezo byanjye.
dialogue.translation: Because of that, I want to continue explaining my thoughts.

dialogue.translation: It is up to us to decide on what we need to continue doing in matters of intervention.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kweli, ariko ubwenge bw’umuntu buratekereza neza kubera ibitekerezo by’abandi.
dialogue.translation: Truly, but the wisdom of a person considers well because of the thoughts of others.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Niba gushaka kwerekana neza, tugomba kwiyongera gutuma abandi bumenye.
dialogue.translation: If we want to explain well, we need to continue making others understand.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, ntibigomba gukoreshwa ubwenge mu kwerekana ibyo twigishwa.
dialogue.translation: But rather, wisdom should be used in explaining what we are taught.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ibyo ni byo kweli, ariko tugomba kwiyongera kwiga gutegura neza.
dialogue.translation: That is truly so, but we need to continue learning to decide well.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kuri iyoyo ngendo, ubwenge bwacu bwigomeka.
dialogue.translation: On that path, our wisdom is tested.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kubera ibyo, tugomba gutuma ibitekerezo byacu bibe neza.
dialogue.translation: Because of that, we need to cause our thoughts to be good.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ni byo kweli, kandi tugomba gushaka kwerekana neza.
dialogue.translation: That is truly so, and we need to want to explain well.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: I’m going to analyze how post-colonial writers have developed their ideas in the years following colonization.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kandi ubwoko bw'ubushakashatsi bafite bugaragaza neza uburyo barekanye kuri ibyo.
dialogue.translation: And the type of perspective they have clearly shows how they approached it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ni byo, ahubwo ntekereza ko kwiyongera kwerekana ibyo bituma ubwenge bwabo bukaze neza.
dialogue.translation: Exactly, rather I think continuing to explain these points makes their intelligence very clear.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mu by'ukuri, uburyo bafite kugira ibitekerezo bikomeye birahagije.
dialogue.translation: Indeed, the way they have profound thoughts is impressive.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kandi ntekereza ko ubwoko bw'ubushakashatsi bafite bukoresha neza mu gutanga amakuru yabo.
dialogue.translation: And I think the type of perspective they have uses their narratives very well.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ni byo, bugaragaza neza uburyo barekanye kuri ibyo.
dialogue.translation: Exactly, they clearly show how they approached it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ahubwo, nzakora kwiyongera kwerekana ibyo mu ngingo yanjye.
dialogue.translation: Instead, I’ll continue to explain these points in my essay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ni ikiza, kugira ubushakashatsi bwiza ni byo bituma ubwenge bukaze.
dialogue.translation: That’s great, having a good perspective is what makes intelligence shine.
